newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL rises after selloff details.
newsitem.headline: MOL rises after selloff details.

text.p: Shares in oil company MOL rallied to 3,200 forints in early trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange after some details of MOL's upcoming selloff came through the market, traders said.
"Clearly the details pushed the price upwards," one trader said.
After an early rally MOL's price retreated and traded at 3,135 forints, up 30, at 0956 GMT.
Traders said foreigners were on the selling side but local speculators were heavy buyers.
Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt on Thursday released details, although has not given the indicative price range, for MOL's planned sales.
Accordingly, Hungary will offer at least 12.5 percent of MOL shares, giving an over-allotment option of 2.5 percent.
Domestic investors will be offered one percent to which another one percent can be added in case of oversubscription.
Following an international roadshow between April 21 and May 2, the pricing and allocation of the shares will come on May 6.
